exposure: Parental perspectives on safe home care practices for premature babies
cohort: The study included 18 parents of premature babies under 1 year of age.
finding: Elements related to safe home care for premature babies were identified, including aspects of home arrival, preserving baby health and development, support for safe home care, and the development of parental care to promote baby safety.
cross-section timing: Parents were interviewed when their premature babies were under 1 year of age.
